QUOTE: There is no pybind11 or C++ extension. The Python package is a `ctypes` binding over the C ABI in `include/entropic/entropic.h`: ... `load()` ... returns a `ctypes.CDLL`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states ctypes loading of librentropic.so via CDLL and explicitly rules out pybind11/C++ extension modules.
